title: Approved, scenario-specific incident response plan
objective: An approved plan with severity model and playbooks covering Unbound-specific scenarios is reviewed annually and after significant incidents.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Defined incident roles, on-call and external support
objective: Incident commander, deputies and on-call coverage are defined with no single-person dependency; outside counsel and forensic support are pre-arranged; customer contacts are verified at least quarterly.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Annual tabletop and technical response exercises
objective: At least annual tabletop exercises and semiannual technical drills with timing measurement and tracked corrective actions.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Obligation-driven notification workflow with deadline tracking
objective: Each incident is evaluated against the notification obligation matrix; deadlines start automatically at the defined trigger; notifications are sent over authenticated channels and logged with acknowledgment.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Forensic preservation and chain of custody
objective: On incident declaration, relevant logs, snapshots and agent ledgers are preserved with hashes and custody records under legal hold.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Post-incident review feeding threats, tests and detections
objective: Every significant incident produces a root cause analysis, a customer summary and tracked corrective actions, and updates threat models, invariants, regression tests and detections.
implementing_systems: Tutela (requires incidents to feed threats, invariants and regression evidence; not operated)
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Ransomware resilience and ransom decision policy
objective: Backups are immutable or isolated from production credentials and restore-tested; any ransom decision follows an approved policy with counsel, insurer and sanctions screening.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)

title: Rapid containment including platform holds and agent kill switch
objective: Pre-authorized containment actions (credential revocation, tenant isolation, sponsor-policy holds that never move funds, AI agent kill switch) execute within minutes and notify the sponsor's designated officer immediately.
owner: Unassigned (proposed role: Security Lead, per UNB-CTRL matrix proposed owners)
